metadata.target_feature: Emergency Lane Keeping (ELK) - Car-to-Car Overtaking Drift Evasion

regulatory_provenance.specific_clause: Euro NCAP Lane Departure Protocol v1.2 Section 3.2.2 & Figure 3-5

input_context.user_intent: The vehicle shall prevent collision during unintentional lane drift into an overtaking vehicle. When traveling at 70 km/h and drifting toward the driver's side (lateral velocity 0.3 to 0.6 m/s) while another vehicle is overtaking in the adjacent lane at 80 km/h, the system must steer the vehicle back to avoid a 25% side impact.

operational_design_domain.road_type: Multi-lane roadway, center dashed marking, overtaking vehicle 1.5 m from center line

decomposition_targets.description: Monitor rear quarter radar for faster closing overtaking partner in adjacent lane
Counteract unintentional steering drift toward overtaking vehicle

formal_requirements.statement: When VehSpd_kph == 70.0 km/h, OvertakingTargetSpd_kph == 80.0 km/h, TurnIndicatorState == OFF, and LateralVelocity_mps >= 0.3 m/s toward the adjacent lane with OvertakingTargetDist_m <= 10.0 m, ELK_OvertakeIntervention shall assert true within an FTTI of 40 ms ensuring CollisionOccurred_flag == false.
